output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the owner calls mintToken, the amount of tokens to be minted is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the balance of the contract to become extremely large, and in turn, the owner's balance to become extremely large, causing a denial of service to users.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] += _value overflows, it becomes zero, causing a denial of service to the recipients.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] += _value overflows, it becomes zero, causing a denial of service to the recipients.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is calculated, it can overflow and cause a denial of service to users.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is calculated, it can overflow and cause a denial of service to users.
